messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Spike: /v1/embeddings 5xx rate increased to 18% over 10m in eu-west-1. p95 latency ~2.4s. Affected: multiple high-volume embed jobs. Incident INC-1765. Auto-page -> @maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): Ack. Paging oncall now. grabbing logs + routing table.

sourav: I see a sudden qps bump from a small set of clients hitting the embeddings hot route. KV cache miss rate increased.

lex: Can we do a surgical per-endpoint carve rather than wide model fallback? Prefer to avoid global degradations for chat.

maria (oncall): Agreed. Plan: 1) throttle public embeddings route to reduce load 2) carve enterprise slice for priority tenants 3) temporarily disable rerank-on-embed-disabled flag for non-critical routes 4) notify impacted customers. Executing step 1 now.

maria (oncall): Running live command (console snippet):
```bash
# reduce public embeddings QPS to 2.5k across eu-west-1
redwoodctl quotas update --route "/v1/embeddings" --region eu-west-1 --limit 2500 --scope public --reason "INC-1765 live mitigation"
```

sourav: Copy. I'm watching the shard metrics. If 5xxs drop we keep and then carve. If not, we'll disable non-essential rerank and enable model-fallback to smaller embed model.

lex: For carve: create a slice for customers tagged enterprise with a reserved pool. Command: 
```bash
redwoodctl slices create --name enterprise-slice --route "/v1/embeddings" --region eu-west-1 --qps 8000 --priority high --tenants "enterprise"
```
We then move enterprise-affiliated tokens to that slice to avoid impact.

elaine (support): I'll draft a short advisory for impacted customers: note degraded throughput for embeddings in eu-west-1, mitigation in progress, ETA for updates ~30–60m. cc: support channels.

ben (pm): What's the customer impact radius? Which SLAs trigger escalation?

maria (oncall): Initial customer list: 4 medium/1 large customers showing errors on embed ingest. We'll classify large customer as P1. SLA team notified.

sourav: Quick toggle if carving doesn't help: disable rerank path that chains embeddings->rerank for non-enterprise. Command: 
```bash
redwoodctl routes patch --id rerank-path --enabled false --scope public --reason "INC-1765 reduce downstream load"
```

maria (oncall): After initial quota update: 5xxs dropped to 6% and p95 latency down to ~1.1s. Good signal. Proceed with carve for enterprise.

lex: Carve created, moving tokens for 2 enterprise tenants. Confirmed throughput on slice stable.

elaine (support): Sent advisory to impacted customers listing temporary throttling to embeddings and potential delays. No custom data exposure. Customers replied, one requested ETA — told them 45m.

ben (pm): Thanks. What's rollback plan if carve causes unforeseen side-effects?

maria (oncall): Rollback: revert quotas to previous values with redwoodctl quotas update --route "/v1/embeddings" --limit <prev> and re-enable rerank with routes patch. We will keep a 15m observation window after each change.

sourav: Note: telemetry shows a downstream cache miss introduced after a model version diff earlier today. Follow-up action: investigate model onboarding pipeline and add canary checks for embedding KV cache pressure.

maria (oncall): Handoff summary for next oncall:
- Incident INC-1765: embeddings 5xx spike in eu-west-1.
- Live mitigations applied: public QPS -> 2500, enterprise slice created (8000 qps), rerank disabled for public if needed.
- Customer impact: 4 med / 1 large impacted; advisory sent.
- Metrics to watch: 5xx rate, p95 latency, cache miss %, enterprise slice saturation.
- Follow-ups: root cause trace on model diff, improve canary tests, postmortem owner: @sourav.

elaine (support): I'll own customer follow-ups + post-update notifications.

ben (pm): I'll take notes for the postmortem and coordinate CS/AE comms.

maria (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated but keeping thread open for next 60m. If anything regresses, page escalation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [NOTE] Incident INC-1765 status -> mitigated. Timestamped actions recorded.
